fusions.name: Hidden Point
fusions.desc: A thrust at a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full range. Its reach is 40% longer. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Flicked Edge
fusions.desc: Flicks a blade from the fork's haft at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage with a 30% chance to leave it [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Palmed Trick
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Clean Cut
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
